provenance.method: Stand-in: static thrust scaled with (V / test V)² (thrust ~ rpm², rpm ~ V), divided by the AUW estimate.
assumptions: motor figures interpolate linearly between the 10 rows of the maker's table (0 at 0 % throttle); pack current = table electrical power ÷ 22.2 V nominal
maker's table used the MEPS SZ4942 prop at 25.2 V, not the fitted propeller
avionics: DJI O4 minimum supply power 10 W, GNSS 50 mA at 5 V, FC + receiver 2.5 W (assumed), BEC efficiency 85 % (assumed)

all-up weight = 584 g from systemMass (derived:mass.all_up, of which 151.2 g is CAD volume × assumed material) + 20 g assumed for the 4 parts with no mass in the model (FC/ESC SH1.0 8-pin cable, Panasonic EEU-FR1V471 470 µF 35 V low-ESR electrolytic capacitor, XT60 battery lead (12 AWG), DJI O4 3-in-1 cable)
